title: the fractal folds on the stop hits, then the bright snares return
story: ARE WE STILL FRIENDS feels at 60 BPM (autocorrelation lag 32), not the tracker's 184.6. Before the break the snare strokes flash the peach set (col_bri, contrast) and the lowest groove hit folds it once. At 3499 the colour drains to 0.7 and the set slows (deriva 0.35 to 0.15). The three stop hits (3511, 3525, 3542) each fold, push and flash the picture; the chord turns fold it again and the hue sways with the voice. When the beat returns at 3718 the bright snare flashes, colour comes back, and the dark hits keep folding the set in the steady post-roll.
